proposal.expected_benefit: Improved readiness to detect and respond to real-world threats, reducing the risk of overconfidence in the system's capabilities.
proposal.problem: The current strategy may lead to overconfidence in the system's ability to detect real-world threats due to the simulation-only nature of the scenario.
proposal.proposed_change: Integrate real-time monitoring and dynamic threat intelligence into the mitigation strategy to address evolving attack vectors, ensuring the system remains effective against real-world adversarial scenarios.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-World Threat Preparedness
verification_tests: Evaluate system performance against real-world threat data
Assess the integration of dynamic threat intelligence mechanisms
Test the effectiveness of real-time monitoring in detecting novel attack patterns
